description:
Kim Heesu has never once lost his title as the top student of the entire school. Not until the talk-of-the-town transfer student, Yoon Seoju—a guy shrouded in mystery—appears right in front of him.

*“Heesu is... such a fool. That's what makes him cute.”*

Heesu thinks they belong to completely different worlds and could never get close. Yet, just as his heart begins to open thanks to Seoju’s strangely friendly approach, a certain incident drives them apart once again...

*“H-Heesu! I heard Yoon Seoju got a perfect score on this mock exam...!”*

Heesu’s peaceful life, which depended entirely on maintaining his rank as the top student, begins to shatter into pieces with Seoju’s arrival.

*“You hate me, don’t you, Heesu?”*  
*“Just don’t run away or disappear. You can hit me, curse at me, or be angry at me all you want.”* *(Source: RIDI, translated)*
